correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of C=Nx and D=N(1-x) gives Cdot=C(1-N/K)F_C and Ddot=D(1-N/K)F_D. Strictly positive payoffs imply both counts strictly grow, N->K with an exponential capacity deficit, hence strict attainable-endpoint bounds and integrable x(t)-x∞. The log-odds derivative of resource is epsilon(1+theta)(x-rho), proving exactly 0/interior/1 limits. The fixed U1 attainability proof is substantive: choose U0=L[[q,q],[1,1]], let L->infinity in fast time, retain n≈n0 and uniformly bound terminal-tail frequency error by remaining capacity; continuous dependence and intermediate value over q produce every interior terminal share. Explicit independent algebra checks confirm C,D identities. Source-only constant-row U0=U1 shortcut would not suffice when U1 is fixed, but the fast-time proof addresses that quantifier.
